query: select m.ts_code,m.trade_date,m.close,b.dv_ttm,b.ts_code as basic_code from (select ts_code,trade_date,close from backtest_daily where trade_date >= '2026-09-30' and trade_date < '2026-10-01') m left join (select ts_code,trade_date,dv_ttm from daily_basic where trade_date >= '2026-09-30' and trade_date < '2026-10-01') b on (ts_code,trade_date) order by m.ts_code,m.trade_date limit 3
